headline: Lumentum Stock Leads S&P 500 Higher Following Anthropic IPO Filing
summary: Optical stocks staged a comeback, led by Lumentum, following Anthropic's IPO filing and positive sector developments.
why: Artificial intelligence infrastructure demand directly benefits optical component suppliers whose hardware supports high-bandwidth data centre networks.

impacts.name: Lumentum Holdings
impacts.why: Broader enthusiasm for AI sector growth via high-profile IPO filings increases demand for optical networking components.

why_moved: Anthropic's IPO filing catalysed renewed investor enthusiasm for artificial intelligence supply-chain hardware and optical networking providers.
